cells.source: # Ensembles and clustering with renamed parameters

from sklearn.datasets import make_classification, make_blobs
from sklearn.ensemble import BaggingClassifier
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans, AgglomerativeClustering

X, y = make_classification(n_samples=200, n_features=6, random_state=7)
bag = BaggingClassifier(base_estimator=DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=3), n_estimators=10, random_state=7).fit(X, y)
print(round(bag.score(X, y), 4))

P, _ = make_blobs(n_samples=90, centers=3, random_state=2)
km = KMeans(n_clusters=3, algorithm='full', n_init=10, random_state=0).fit(P)
print(round(km.inertia_, 3))
